module.publicSeam: ic-* custom elements and central --ui-* tokens
module.adapter: Web Awesome remains replaceable inside the implementation boundary.
module.responsibility: Collect single-line and multi-line text while Form Field owns the accessible label, description and validation relationship.

contract.evidence: User approved the other four judgments and approved the clarified boundary: ic-textarea remains plain text while Smart Canvas mentions, image and prompt references, and Token/Chip composition belong to a separate structured Composer Pattern.

live.evidence: User explicitly approved the corrected Text Entry/Form Field live visual and interaction matrix after layout, focus-frame and Dark theme fixes.

judgments: ic-input is for a single text-like value; numeric adjustment and color picking are separate families.

ic-textarea is for authored multi-line plain text; Smart Canvas mentions, image and prompt references, and Token/Chip composition are supported by a separate structured Composer Pattern that reuses Text Entry and Form Field foundations.

ic-form-field owns the accessible name, Hint and Validation relationships; a visible label is optional only when aria-label supplies the non-visual accessible name, and placeholder never replaces either.
Invalid is a semantic state with text and programmatic association, never color alone.
Loading is excluded because text entry has no honest generic loading behavior; async work belongs to the surrounding flow.
ic-input appearance=outlined is the default bordered surface; appearance=subtle uses --ui-color-surface-subtle without a border for lower-emphasis text and search entry.

components.purpose: Collect one text-like value with native form and validation behavior.

slots.end: One ic-button or ic-icon-button, or one of each, when end-action is present. Embedded icon-only actions use ic-icon-button background=ghost; the search clear action stays hidden until the field receives focus.

components.purpose: Collect authored multi-line plain text with native form and validation behavior.
Compose one text control with either a visible label or a non-visual aria-label, plus optional hint and validation message.

legacyCoverage.rule: All classified ic-input and ic-textarea evidence is accounted for. Legacy counts prove coverage, not target variants or appearance.
